verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's FAQ documents data retention controls covering code-related data such as learnings and review context. Model output logging is a separate setting you can control, and self-hosted Enterprise users can opt out of all data retention at any time. The no-training statement adds to the privacy posture but does not itself give retention or deletion control. The evidence never describes explicit deletion, how retention works on the cloud plans, or retention periods. Missing for 10: documented data deletion/purge workflow, cloud-tier retention configuration details (scope, durations), full opt-out outside self-hosted Enterprise, independent corroboration.
